name: directory.create
description: Create a directory. Brings something new into existence — classified C. Renamed from file.mkdir in v2.1.

parents.description: When true, creates intermediate directories as needed (mkdir -p semantics).

mode.description: POSIX mode bits as a decimal integer; default 493 = 0755. Ignored on Windows.

windows-modern.description: CreateDirectoryW. Long-path \\?\ prefix supported. parents:true walks the path components, creating each missing one.

windows-classic.description: CreateDirectoryA on NT 4 / 9x; CreateDirectoryW on NT 5+. parents:true walks components in either case.
